name: jira3
description: Local-first Jira tracking: task files in the repo are the source of truth; a zero-dependency CLI mirrors them to Jira (create/update/transition/comment) via detached hooks, so the working session never spends tokens or wall-clock on Jira I/O. Includes git-flow: branches/PRs/CI verdicts derived from task files (epic branches, Jira-key naming for automatic Development-panel linking). Done transitions require explicit human approval.
